business_summary: Chongqing Zongshen Power Machinery Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sale of small and medium-sized power machinery products, and end-products in China and internationally. The company operates through Engines; General Machinery; Parent Company and Products Parts; and Supply Chain Finance segments. It offers motor engines; and general machinery products, such as welding stations, high pressure cleaners, clean water pumps, motorhome generators, general purpose gasoline engine, countryside steward shepherd, mini tiller, parking generator, and heavy truck starting lithium battery. The company also provides components, including gearbox housing, cylinder block, clutch housing, and right and left side of gearboxes, as well as electric drive system, electric motor powertrain, and electric motor powertrain components; and box assembly, box body, box cover, cylinder head assembly for motorcycles. In addition, it offers general machinery comprising enclosures, enclosure combination, enclosure assembly, and box body and lid assembly; generator set; lawn mower, power engine, and variable frequency generator; and technical services. Further, the company is involved in finance business; and real estate business. It exports its products to countries and regions in North America, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Oceania. The company was formerly known as Chengdu Lianyi Industrial Co., Ltd and changed its name to Chongqing Zongshen Power Machinery Co.,Ltd in 2005. Chongqing Zongshen Power Machinery Co.,Ltd was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Chongqing, China.
